title: Multilinear tensor-power bound Σ_i β(Le∘i)² ≤ (‖L‖²)^j·Σ_i β(e′∘i)²
statement:
For all P, Q, j ∈ ℕ, every continuous linear map L : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q (L : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q) and every j-multilinear map β : (ℝ^Q)^j → ℝ (β : MultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Eucl Q) ℝ, not necessarily alternating or continuous):
Σ_{i : Fin j → Fin P} β(L e_{i(1)}, …, L e_{i(j)})² ≤ (‖L‖²)^j·Σ_{i : Fin j → Fin Q} β(e′_{i(1)}, …, e′_{i(j)})².
Here:
- e and e′ are the standard bases of ℝ^P and ℝ^Q (EuclideanSpace.basisFun);
- ‖L‖ is the operator norm for the Euclidean norms.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q j : ℕ) (L : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q) (β : MultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Eucl Q) ℝ), ∑ i : Fin j → Fin P, (β (fun k => L (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (i k)))) ^ 2 ≤ (‖L‖ ^ 2) ^ j * ∑ i : Fin j → Fin Q, (β (fun k => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin Q) ℝ (i k))) ^ 2
